purpose: Complete local maintenance transaction over the full existing strict-change cohort; no new prevalence or speedup claim.
selection: All 50,931 receipts in source order, no sampling; classes rebuilt from actual receipts with no saved diagnostics or ID mapping. All 20 normalized observation classes receive one literal representative report. Every receipt receives a checked replacement.
ordering: One integrated service, fixed dependency order. Warmup then five fresh child processes; no comparison requiring rotating method order. No outcome-dependent timing exclusions.

measurement_boundaries.included: Retained archive hashing/read/parsing, schema/binding validation and class grouping; full source hash/read/index; representative admission/diagnosis, literal witnesses and robust obligations; full exact-ID construction; unchanged checked per-receipt P-first repair API; gzip ledger encoding; artifact JSON/gzip serialization; file flush/fsync and directory fsync; reopened-file checksums, portable report verification, independent ID/response/replacement semantic verification.
measurement_boundaries.source_setup: Hashes and indexes all 251,734 public-derived source cases inside the integrated timer. Subsequent 33,489 profile acquisitions are logical reads from this memory index, not physical source I/O reductions. Caller-supplied local public-source capabilities authorize P/T.
measurement_boundaries.shared_classes: 20 representative reports cover normalized observation classes, with exact case-to-class mapping independently rebuilt. Reports preserve exemplar literals; this is not 50,931 separately serialized witness reports.
measurement_boundaries.persistence: Creates new output files, flushes and fsyncs each, then fsyncs the output directory and its parent. Immediately reopens and verifies persisted bytes. OS page caches are not flushed; no cold-cache latency, actual storage power-loss durability, network or authentication measurement.
measurement_boundaries.clock: perf_counter_ns wall and process_time_ns CPU for each nonoverlapping phase and actual integrated total. Phase medians need not sum to median total. Python imports, protocol parsing and independent-checker imports precede total and are separately reported; child subprocess wall includes startup.
measurement_boundaries.memory: Linux ru_maxrss after each phase and at end is absolute child-process high-water KiB, not incremental method allocation.
measurement_boundaries.verification: Portable verifier plus existing separate stdlib declarative predicates/completion reconstruction checks 20 class witness reports, independently reconstructs all exact IDs and old admission, reconciles each acquired response with source and current request, and checks all 50,931 replacement fibers/literals/raw source decisions.
measurement_boundaries.limits: Five rounds are descriptive same-host medians/ranges. Existing strict transition and public cohort are regression data, not a new industrial deployment. No cross-service speedup or user/productivity claim; no actual authorization service, remote I/O, concurrent production load or transactional rollback measured.
measurement_boundaries.freeze: Protocol, script, tests and all dependency/input hashes captured before any warmup/measured child. Changes require new output directory and retained previous evidence.
